# Update phoenix-ru/fervid

The repository is in `/app/repo`. Update the existing Rust implementation to match the required behavior.

The authoritative documentation is in `/app/docs`. Documentation in the repository may be outdated.

Query `/opt/task-reference/executable` to observe the required behavior. It is execute-only. Do not copy, wrap, or invoke it from your submitted implementation.

The executable compiles UTF-8 Vue single-file component source supplied on standard input. With empty standard input, it compiles the repository's built-in benchmark fixture for compatibility with the original binary.

Modify the existing repository. Do not replace it with an implementation in another language.

Run `/opt/task/build.sh` to build `/app/executable`. The verifier rebuilds your submitted repository offline using the same fixed command. Changes to that command and a prebuilt `/app/executable` are not used for grading. Required dependencies are preloaded. Network access is unavailable. Do not use external source code.

Hidden behavioral tests compare stdout, stderr, exit status, and applicable output files to the reference implementation. Some tests cover required changes, while others ensure existing behavior remains unchanged. Every hidden test must pass. Preserve unchanged behavior while implementing the required changes.
